6/-!
7# Measurability of the paper semantics
8
9The expression space is decomposed into countably many fixed-skeleton fibers.
10On each fiber, reduction is represented by a measurable family of actions;
11these pieces assemble into the global one-step kernel.
12-/
13
14namespace Determinize.Proof.Paper
15
16open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
17open Determinize.Spec.Paper

19noncomputable section

21attribute [local simp] Determinize.Spec.Paper.reduce

23/-- Extending a finite real environment is measurable. -/
24theorem measurable_envCons {n : Nat} :
25 Measurable (fun input : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ) =>
26 Env.cons input.1 input.2) := by
27 rw [measurable_pi_iff]
28 intro i
29 refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
30 · simpa [Env.cons] using
31 (measurable_fst : Measurable (Prod.fst : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ))
32 · change Measurable (fun input : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ) => input.2 j)
33 exact (measurable_pi_apply j).comp measurable_snd

35/-- An s-finite kernel packaged with the instance needed for composition. -/
36structure SFiniteKernel (α β : Type*) [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β] where
37 kernel : Kernel α β
38 sfinite : IsSFiniteKernel kernel
39
40namespace SFiniteKernel
41
42variable {α β γ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
43 [MeasurableSpace γ]
44
45noncomputable def zero : SFiniteKernel α β := ⟨0, inferInstance⟩
46
47noncomputable def deterministic (function : α → β) (measurable : Measurable function) :
48 SFiniteKernel α β := ⟨Kernel.deterministic function measurable, inferInstance⟩
49
50noncomputable def piecewise {set : Set α} (measurableSet : MeasurableSet set)
51 (thenKernel elseKernel : SFiniteKernel α β) : SFiniteKernel α β := by
52 classical
53 letI := thenKernel.sfinite
54 letI := elseKernel.sfinite
55 exact ⟨Kernel.piecewise measurableSet thenKernel.kernel elseKernel.kernel, inferInstance⟩
56
57noncomputable def mapWithInput (draw : SFiniteKernel α β)
58 (transform : α × β → γ) (measurableTransform : Measurable transform) :
59 SFiniteKernel α γ := by
60 letI := draw.sfinite
61 let transformed := Kernel.deterministic transform measurableTransform
62 let paired := draw.kernel ⊗ₖ transformed
63 exact ⟨paired.map Prod.snd, inferInstance⟩
64
65theorem mapWithInput_apply (draw : SFiniteKernel α β)
66 (transform : α × β → γ) (measurableTransform : Measurable transform) (parameter : α) :
67 (mapWithInput draw transform measurableTransform).kernel parameter =
68 Measure.map (fun value => transform (parameter, value)) (draw.kernel parameter) := by
69 let := draw.sfinite
70 ext set measurableSet
71 unfold mapWithInput
72 rw [Kernel.map_apply' _ measurable_snd _ measurableSet,
73 Kernel.compProd_apply (measurable_snd measurableSet)]
74 have sectionMeasurable : Measurable (fun value => transform (parameter, value)) := by
75 fun_prop
76 rw [Measure.map_apply sectionMeasurable measurableSet]
77 simp only [Kernel.deterministic_apply]
78 change (∫⁻ value, (Measure.dirac (transform (parameter, value))) set ∂draw.kernel parameter) = _
79 simp_rw [Measure.dirac_apply' _ measurableSet]
80 change (∫⁻ value, ((fun value => transform (parameter, value)) ⁻¹' set).indicator 1 value
81 ∂draw.kernel parameter) = _
82 rw [lintegral_indicator_one (measurableSet.preimage sectionMeasurable)]
83
84noncomputable def pullback (draw : SFiniteKernel β γ) (parameters : α → β)
85 (measurableParameters : Measurable parameters) : SFiniteKernel α γ := by
86 letI := draw.sfinite
87 exact ⟨draw.kernel ∘ₖ Kernel.deterministic parameters measurableParameters, inferInstance⟩
88
89end SFiniteKernel

91deriving instance Countable for Expr

93/-- The canonical expression with a given skeleton: every literal is `0`. -/
94def zeroFill : Skeleton → Expr
95 | .bvar index => .bvar index
96 | .unit => .unit
97 | .reject => .reject
98 | .discrete kind d => .discrete kind (zeroFill d)
99 | .bool value => .bool value
100 | .real => .real 0
101 | .lam body => .lam (zeroFill body)
102 | .fix body => .fix (zeroFill body)
103 | .app function argument => .app (zeroFill function) (zeroFill argument)
104 | .pair left right => .pair (zeroFill left) (zeroFill right)
105 | .fst pair => .fst (zeroFill pair)
106 | .snd pair => .snd (zeroFill pair)
107 | .inl value => .inl (zeroFill value)
108 | .inr value => .inr (zeroFill value)
109 | .matchSum scrutinee left right =>
110 .matchSum (zeroFill scrutinee) (zeroFill left) (zeroFill right)
111 | .nil => .nil
112 | .cons head tail => .cons (zeroFill head) (zeroFill tail)
113 | .matchList scrutinee nilCase consCase =>
114 .matchList (zeroFill scrutinee) (zeroFill nilCase) (zeroFill consCase)
115 | .ite condition thenBranch elseBranch =>
116 .ite (zeroFill condition) (zeroFill thenBranch) (zeroFill elseBranch)
117 | .letE value body => .letE (zeroFill value) (zeroFill body)
118 | .neg body => .neg (zeroFill body)
119 | .add left right => .add (zeroFill left) (zeroFill right)
120 | .mul left right => .mul (zeroFill left) (zeroFill right)
121 | .div left right => .div (zeroFill left) (zeroFill right)
122 | .lt left right => .lt (zeroFill left) (zeroFill right)
123 | .uniform kind lower upper => .uniform kind (zeroFill lower) (zeroFill upper)
124 | .gaussian kind mean variance => .gaussian kind (zeroFill mean) (zeroFill variance)
125 | .poisson kind rate => .poisson kind (zeroFill rate)
126 | .bernoulli kind probability => .bernoulli kind (zeroFill probability)
127 | .exponential kind rate => .exponential kind (zeroFill rate)
128 | .beta kind left right => .beta kind (zeroFill left) (zeroFill right)
129 | .gamma kind shape rate => .gamma kind (zeroFill shape) (zeroFill rate)
130
131@[simp] theorem zeroFill_skeleton (skeleton : Skeleton) :
132 (zeroFill skeleton).skeleton = skeleton := by
133 induction skeleton <;> simp [zeroFill, Expr.skeleton, *]
134
135namespace RealCoordinates
136
137theorem measurable_code : Measurable RealCoordinates.code :=
138 comap_measurable _
139
140theorem measurable_length :
141 Measurable fun coordinates : RealCoordinates => coordinates.values.length :=
142 measurable_fst.comp measurable_code
143
144theorem measurable_getD (index : Nat) :
145 Measurable fun coordinates : RealCoordinates => coordinates.values.getD index 0 :=
146 (measurable_pi_apply index).comp (measurable_snd.comp measurable_code)
147
148/-- A map into real coordinates is measurable once its length and each of its
149zero-padded coordinates are. -/
150theorem measurable_of_length_getD {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
151 {coordinates : α → RealCoordinates}
152 (lengthMeasurable : Measurable fun parameter => (coordinates parameter).values.length)
153 (coordinateMeasurable : ∀ index : Nat,
154 Measurable fun parameter => (coordinates parameter).values.getD index 0) :
155 Measurable coordinates := by
156 rw [measurable_iff_comap_le]
157 change MeasurableSpace.comap coordinates
158 (MeasurableSpace.comap RealCoordinates.code
159 (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Nat × (Nat → ℝ)))) ≤ _
160 rw [MeasurableSpace.comap_comp]
161 exact (lengthMeasurable.prodMk (measurable_pi_lambda _ coordinateMeasurable)).comap_le
162
163end RealCoordinates
164
165theorem realCoordinates_length (expression : Expr) :
166 expression.realCoordinates.length = expression.skeleton.realArity := by
167 cases expression with
168 | bvar | reject | unit | bool | real | nil =>
169 simp [Expr.realCoordinates, Expr.skeleton, Expr.realArity]
170 | lam body | fix body | fst body | snd body | inl body
171 | inr body | neg body | poisson _ body | bernoulli _ body | exponential _ body | discrete _ body =>
172 simpa [Expr.realCoordinates, Expr.skeleton, Expr.realArity] using
173 realCoordinates_length body
174 | app left right | pair left right | cons left right | add left right
175 | mul left right | div left right | lt left right | letE left right
176 | uniform _ left right | gaussian _ left right | beta _ left right
177 | gamma _ left right =>
178 simpa [Expr.realCoordinates, Expr.skeleton, Expr.realArity] using congrArg₂ (· + ·)
179 (realCoordinates_length left) (realCoordinates_length right)
180 | matchSum first second third | matchList first second third
181 | ite first second third =>
182 simpa [Expr.realCoordinates, Expr.skeleton, Expr.realArity,
183 Nat.add_assoc] using congrArg₂ (· + ·)
184 (realCoordinates_length first)
185 (congrArg₂ (· + ·) (realCoordinates_length second)
186 (realCoordinates_length third))
187
188/-- A family of expressions with a fixed real-free skeleton and
189measurably varying real coordinates. -/
190structure MeasurableFamily (α : Type*) [MeasurableSpace α] (expression : α → Expr) where
191 skeleton : Skeleton
192 skeleton_eq : ∀ parameter, (expression parameter).skeleton = skeleton
193 coordinate_measurable : ∀ index : Nat,
194 Measurable fun parameter => (expression parameter).realCoordinates.getD index 0
195
196/-- Every member of a family has as many real coordinates as the skeleton's real arity. -/
197theorem MeasurableFamily.coordinate_count {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
198 {expression : α → Expr} (family : MeasurableFamily α expression) (parameter : α) :
199 (expression parameter).realCoordinates.length = family.skeleton.realArity := by
200 rw [realCoordinates_length, family.skeleton_eq]
201
202namespace MeasurableFamily
203
204def comp {α β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
205 {expression : α → Expr} (family : MeasurableFamily α expression)
206 (function : β → α) (measurableFunction : Measurable function) :
207 MeasurableFamily β (expression ∘ function) where
208 skeleton := family.skeleton
209 skeleton_eq parameter := family.skeleton_eq (function parameter)
210 coordinate_measurable index :=
211 (family.coordinate_measurable index).comp measurableFunction
212
213/-- Extract a fixed-skeleton child whose coordinates occupy a contiguous block
214of the parent's coordinate traversal. -/
215def extractContiguous {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
216 {parent child : α → Expr} (parentFamily : MeasurableFamily α parent)
217 (childSkeleton : Skeleton) (offset : Nat)
218 (child_skeleton : ∀ parameter, (child parameter).skeleton = childSkeleton)
219 (coordinate_rule : ∀ parameter index, index < childSkeleton.realArity →
220 (child parameter).realCoordinates.getD index 0 =
221 (parent parameter).realCoordinates.getD (offset + index) 0) :
222 MeasurableFamily α child where
223 skeleton := childSkeleton
224 skeleton_eq := child_skeleton
225 coordinate_measurable index := by
226 by_cases inBounds : index < childSkeleton.realArity
227 · have equality :
228 (fun parameter => (child parameter).realCoordinates.getD index 0) =
229 fun parameter => (parent parameter).realCoordinates.getD (offset + index) 0 := by
230 funext parameter
231 exact coordinate_rule parameter index inBounds
232 rw [equality]
233 exact parentFamily.coordinate_measurable _
234 · have equality :
235 (fun parameter => (child parameter).realCoordinates.getD index 0) = fun _ => 0 := by
236 funext parameter
237 rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD,
238 List.getElem?_eq_none (by
239 rw [realCoordinates_length, child_skeleton]
240 exact Nat.le_of_not_gt inBounds)]
241 rfl
242 rw [equality]
243 exact measurable_const
244
245theorem measurable_realCoordinates {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
246 {expression : α → Expr} (family : MeasurableFamily α expression) :
247 Measurable fun parameter => (⟨(expression parameter).realCoordinates⟩ : RealCoordinates) := by
248 apply RealCoordinates.measurable_of_length_getD
249 · have constantLength :
250 (fun parameter => (expression parameter).realCoordinates.length) =
251 fun _ => family.skeleton.realArity :=
252 funext family.coordinate_count
253 change Measurable fun parameter => (expression parameter).realCoordinates.length
254 rw [constantLength]
255 exact measurable_const
256 · exact family.coordinate_measurable
257
258theorem measurable {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
259 {expression : α → Expr} (family : MeasurableFamily α expression) :
260 Measurable expression := by
261 rw [measurable_iff_comap_le]
262 change MeasurableSpace.comap expression
263 (MeasurableSpace.comap code (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace Code)) ≤
264 (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace α)
265 rw [MeasurableSpace.comap_comp]
266 have codeMeasurable : Measurable fun parameter => code (expression parameter) := by
267 simp only [code]
268 apply Measurable.prod
269 · convert (measurable_const : Measurable fun _ : α => family.skeleton) using 1
270 funext parameter
271 exact family.skeleton_eq parameter
272 · exact family.measurable_realCoordinates
273 exact codeMeasurable.comap_le
274
275def constant {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (expression : Expr) :
276 MeasurableFamily α (fun _ => expression) where
277 skeleton := expression.skeleton
278 skeleton_eq _ := rfl
279 coordinate_measurable _ := measurable_const
280
281def realLiteral :
282 MeasurableFamily ℝ (fun value => Expr.real value) where
283 skeleton := .real
284 skeleton_eq _ := by simp [Expr.skeleton]
285 coordinate_measurable index := by
286 cases index with
287 | zero =>
288 have functionEq :
289 (fun value : ℝ => (Expr.real value).realCoordinates.getD 0 0) = id := by
290 funext value
291 simp [Expr.realCoordinates, List.getD]
292 rw [functionEq]
293 exact measurable_id
294 | succ index => simp [Expr.realCoordinates, List.getD]
295
296/-- Combine two fixed-skeleton families through a constructor whose coordinate
297traversal is concatenation. -/
298def combine {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
299 {left right : α → Expr} (leftFamily : MeasurableFamily α left)
300 (rightFamily : MeasurableFamily α right)
301 (constructor : Expr → Expr → Expr) (skeletonConstructor : Skeleton → Skeleton → Skeleton)
302 (skeleton_rule : ∀ l r, (constructor l r).skeleton =
303 skeletonConstructor l.skeleton r.skeleton)
304 (coordinates_rule : ∀ l r, (constructor l r).realCoordinates =
305 l.realCoordinates ++ r.realCoordinates) :
306 MeasurableFamily α (fun parameter => constructor (left parameter) (right parameter)) where
307 skeleton := skeletonConstructor leftFamily.skeleton rightFamily.skeleton
308 skeleton_eq parameter := by
309 rw [skeleton_rule, leftFamily.skeleton_eq, rightFamily.skeleton_eq]
310 coordinate_measurable index := by
311 by_cases beforeRight : index < leftFamily.skeleton.realArity
312 · have functionEq :
313 (fun parameter =>
314 (constructor (left parameter) (right parameter)).realCoordinates.getD index 0) =
315 (fun parameter => (left parameter).realCoordinates.getD index 0) := by
316 funext parameter
317 rw [coordinates_rule, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_append,
318 leftFamily.coordinate_count parameter, if_pos beforeRight,
319 ← List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
320 rw [functionEq]
321 exact leftFamily.coordinate_measurable index
322 · have afterLeft : leftFamily.skeleton.realArity ≤ index := Nat.le_of_not_gt beforeRight
323 have functionEq :
324 (fun parameter =>
325 (constructor (left parameter) (right parameter)).realCoordinates.getD index 0) =
326 (fun parameter =>
327 (right parameter).realCoordinates.getD
328 (index - leftFamily.skeleton.realArity) 0) := by
329 funext parameter
330 rw [coordinates_rule, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_append,
331 leftFamily.coordinate_count parameter, if_neg beforeRight,
332 ← List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
333 rw [functionEq]
334 exact rightFamily.coordinate_measurable _
335
336def app {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {left right : α → Expr} (leftFamily : MeasurableFamily α left)
337 (rightFamily : MeasurableFamily α right) :
338 MeasurableFamily α (fun parameter => .app (left parameter) (right parameter)) :=
339 combine leftFamily rightFamily .app .app
340 (by intros; simp [Expr.skeleton]) (by intros; simp [Expr.realCoordinates])
341
342def pair {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {left right : α → Expr} (leftFamily : MeasurableFamily α left)
343 (rightFamily : MeasurableFamily α right) :
344 MeasurableFamily α (fun parameter => .pair (left parameter) (right parameter)) :=
345 combine leftFamily rightFamily .pair .pair
346 (by intros; simp [Expr.skeleton]) (by intros; simp [Expr.realCoordinates])
347
348def cons {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {left right : α → Expr} (leftFamily : MeasurableFamily α left)
349 (rightFamily : MeasurableFamily α right) :
350 MeasurableFamily α (fun parameter => .cons (left parameter) (right parameter)) :=
351 combine leftFamily rightFamily .cons .cons
352 (by intros; simp [Expr.skeleton]) (by intros; simp [Expr.realCoordinates])
353
354def add {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
355 {left right : α → Expr} (leftFamily : MeasurableFamily α left)
356 (rightFamily : MeasurableFamily α right) :
357 MeasurableFamily α (fun parameter => .add (left parameter) (right parameter)) :=
358 combine leftFamily rightFamily .add .add
359 (by intros; simp [Expr.skeleton]) (by intros; simp [Expr.realCoordinates])
360
361def mul {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
362 {left right : α → Expr} (leftFamily : MeasurableFamily α left)
363 (rightFamily : MeasurableFamily α right) :
364 MeasurableFamily α (fun parameter => .mul (left parameter) (right parameter)) :=
365 combine leftFamily rightFamily .mul .mul
366 (by intros; simp [Expr.skeleton]) (by intros; simp [Expr.realCoordinates])
367
368def div {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
369 {left right : α → Expr} (leftFamily : MeasurableFamily α left)
370 (rightFamily : MeasurableFamily α right) :
371 MeasurableFamily α (fun parameter => .div (left parameter) (right parameter)) :=
372 combine leftFamily rightFamily .div .div
373 (by intros; simp [Expr.skeleton]) (by intros; simp [Expr.realCoordinates])
374
375def lt {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
376 {left right : α → Expr} (leftFamily : MeasurableFamily α left)
377 (rightFamily : MeasurableFamily α right) :
378 MeasurableFamily α (fun parameter => .lt (left parameter) (right parameter)) :=
379 combine leftFamily rightFamily Expr.lt Expr.lt
380 (by intros; simp [Expr.skeleton]) (by intros; simp [Expr.realCoordinates])

382/-- Lift a unary constructor whose real-coordinate traversal is unchanged. -/
383def wrap {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {body : α → Expr}
384 (bodyFamily : MeasurableFamily α body)
385 (constructor : Expr → Expr) (skeletonConstructor : Skeleton → Skeleton)
386 (skeleton_rule : ∀ expression, (constructor expression).skeleton =
387 skeletonConstructor expression.skeleton)
388 (coordinates_rule : ∀ expression, (constructor expression).realCoordinates =
389 expression.realCoordinates) :
390 MeasurableFamily α (fun parameter => constructor (body parameter)) where
391 skeleton := skeletonConstructor bodyFamily.skeleton
392 skeleton_eq parameter := by rw [skeleton_rule, bodyFamily.skeleton_eq]
393 coordinate_measurable index := by
394 have functionEq :
395 (fun parameter => (constructor (body parameter)).realCoordinates.getD index 0) =
396 (fun parameter => (body parameter).realCoordinates.getD index 0) := by
397 funext parameter
398 rw [coordinates_rule]
399 rw [functionEq]
400 exact bodyFamily.coordinate_measurable index
401
402def fst {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {body : α → Expr}
403 (family : MeasurableFamily α body) :
404 MeasurableFamily α (fun parameter => .fst (body parameter)) :=
405 wrap family .fst .fst
406 (by intros; simp [Expr.skeleton]) (by intros; simp [Expr.realCoordinates])
407
408def snd {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {body : α → Expr}
409 (family : MeasurableFamily α body) :
410 MeasurableFamily α (fun parameter => .snd (body parameter)) :=
411 wrap family .snd .snd
412 (by intros; simp [Expr.skeleton]) (by intros; simp [Expr.realCoordinates])
413
414def inl {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {body : α → Expr}
415 (family : MeasurableFamily α body) :
416 MeasurableFamily α (fun parameter => .inl (body parameter)) :=
417 wrap family .inl .inl
418 (by intros; simp [Expr.skeleton]) (by intros; simp [Expr.realCoordinates])
419
420def inr {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {body : α → Expr}
421 (family : MeasurableFamily α body) :
422 MeasurableFamily α (fun parameter => .inr (body parameter)) :=
423 wrap family .inr .inr
424 (by intros; simp [Expr.skeleton]) (by intros; simp [Expr.realCoordinates])
425
426def neg {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {body : α → Expr}
427 (family : MeasurableFamily α body) :
428 MeasurableFamily α (fun parameter => .neg (body parameter)) :=
429 wrap family .neg .neg
430 (by intros; simp [Expr.skeleton]) (by intros; simp [Expr.realCoordinates])

434namespace Expr

436/-- Structural child projections used on a fixed skeleton fiber. Their
437fallback is unreachable once the enclosing skeleton constructor is fixed. -/
438def firstChild : Expr → Expr
439 | .lam body | .fix body | .fst body | .snd body
440 | .inl body | .inr body | .neg body => body
441 | .app left _ | .pair left _ | .cons left _ | .add left _
442 | .mul left _ | .div left _ | .lt left _ => left
443 | .uniform _ left _ | .gaussian _ left _ | .beta _ left _ | .gamma _ left _ => left
444 | .poisson _ body | .bernoulli _ body | .exponential _ body | .discrete _ body => body
445 | .matchSum first _ _ | .matchList first _ _ | .ite first _ _ => first
446 | .letE first _ => first
447 | expression => expression
448
449def secondChild : Expr → Expr
450 | .app _ right | .pair _ right | .cons _ right | .add _ right
451 | .mul _ right | .div _ right | .lt _ right => right
452 | .uniform _ _ right | .gaussian _ _ right | .beta _ _ right | .gamma _ _ right => right
453 | .matchSum _ second _ | .matchList _ second _ | .ite _ second _ => second
454 | .letE _ second => second
455 | expression => expression
456
457def thirdChild : Expr → Expr
458 | .matchSum _ _ third | .matchList _ _ third | .ite _ _ third => third
459 | expression => expression
460
461end Expr

463namespace Skeleton
464
465def firstChild : Skeleton → Skeleton
466 | .lam body | .fix body | .fst body | .snd body
467 | .inl body | .inr body | .neg body => body
468 | .app left _ | .pair left _ | .cons left _ | .add left _
469 | .mul left _ | .div left _ | .lt left _ => left
470 | .uniform _ left _ | .gaussian _ left _ | .beta _ left _ | .gamma _ left _ => left
471 | .poisson _ body | .bernoulli _ body | .exponential _ body | .discrete _ body => body
472 | .matchSum first _ _ | .matchList first _ _ | .ite first _ _ => first
473 | .letE first _ => first
474 | skeleton => skeleton
475
476def secondChild : Skeleton → Skeleton
477 | .app _ right | .pair _ right | .cons _ right | .add _ right
478 | .mul _ right | .div _ right | .lt _ right => right
479 | .uniform _ _ right | .gaussian _ _ right | .beta _ _ right | .gamma _ _ right => right
480 | .matchSum _ second _ | .matchList _ second _ | .ite _ second _ => second
481 | .letE _ second => second
482 | skeleton => skeleton
483
484def thirdChild : Skeleton → Skeleton
485 | .matchSum _ _ third | .matchList _ _ third | .ite _ _ third => third
486 | skeleton => skeleton
487
488def secondOffset : Skeleton → Nat
489 | .app first _ | .pair first _ | .cons first _ | .add first _
490 | .mul first _ | .div first _ | .lt first _ => first.realArity
491 | .uniform _ first _ | .gaussian _ first _ | .beta _ first _ | .gamma _ first _ =>
492 first.realArity
493 | .matchSum first _ _ | .matchList first _ _ | .ite first _ _ => first.realArity
494 | .letE first _ => first.realArity
495 | _ => 0
496
497def thirdOffset : Skeleton → Nat
498 | .matchSum first second _ | .matchList first second _
499 | .ite first second _ => first.realArity + second.realArity
500 | _ => 0
501
502end Skeleton

504theorem firstChild_skeleton (expression : Expr) :
505 (Expr.firstChild expression).skeleton = Skeleton.firstChild expression.skeleton := by
506 cases expression <;> simp [Expr.firstChild, Expr.skeleton, Skeleton.firstChild]
507
508theorem secondChild_skeleton (expression : Expr) :
509 (Expr.secondChild expression).skeleton = Skeleton.secondChild expression.skeleton := by
510 cases expression <;> simp [Expr.secondChild, Expr.skeleton, Skeleton.secondChild]
511
512theorem thirdChild_skeleton (expression : Expr) :
513 (Expr.thirdChild expression).skeleton = Skeleton.thirdChild expression.skeleton := by
514 cases expression <;> simp [Expr.thirdChild, Expr.skeleton, Skeleton.thirdChild]

516/-- `List.getD_append_right` at an index offset by the left length, the form the coordinate
517lemmas rewrite with. -/
518theorem list_getD_append_right {α : Type*} (left right : List α) (index : Nat)
519 (default : α) :
520 (left ++ right).getD (left.length + index) default = right.getD index default := by
521 rw [List.getD_append_right _ _ _ _ (Nat.le_add_right _ _), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
522
523theorem list_getD_append_middle {α : Type*} (first second third : List α) (index : Nat)
524 (default : α) (inBounds : index < second.length) :
525 (first ++ second ++ third).getD (first.length + index) default =
526 second.getD index default := by
527 rw [List.append_assoc]
528 rw [list_getD_append_right first (second ++ third), List.getD_append _ _ _ _ inBounds]
529
530theorem firstChild_coordinates_decompose (expression : Expr) :
531 ∃ suffix, expression.realCoordinates =
532 (Expr.firstChild expression).realCoordinates ++ suffix := by
533 cases expression <;>
534 simp [Expr.firstChild, Expr.realCoordinates]
535
536theorem secondChild_coordinates_decompose (expression : Expr) :
537 ∃ front suffix, expression.realCoordinates =
538 front ++ (Expr.secondChild expression).realCoordinates ++ suffix ∧
539 front.length = Skeleton.secondOffset expression.skeleton := by
540 cases expression <;>
541 simp [Expr.secondChild, Expr.skeleton, Expr.realCoordinates, Skeleton.secondOffset]
542 case app function argument | pair function argument | cons function argument |
543 add function argument | mul function argument | div function argument |
544 lt function argument | uniform _ function argument | gaussian _ function argument |
545 beta _ function argument | gamma _ function argument =>
546 exact ⟨function.realCoordinates, ⟨[], by simp⟩, realCoordinates_length function⟩
547 case matchSum scrutinee left right | matchList scrutinee left right |
548 ite scrutinee left right =>
549 exact ⟨scrutinee.realCoordinates, ⟨right.realCoordinates, by simp⟩,
550 realCoordinates_length scrutinee⟩
551 case letE value body =>
552 exact ⟨value.realCoordinates, ⟨[], by simp⟩, realCoordinates_length value⟩
553
554theorem thirdChild_coordinates_decompose (expression : Expr) :
555 ∃ front, expression.realCoordinates =
556 front ++ (Expr.thirdChild expression).realCoordinates ∧
557 front.length = Skeleton.thirdOffset expression.skeleton := by
558 cases expression <;>
559 simp [Expr.thirdChild, Expr.skeleton, Expr.realCoordinates, Skeleton.thirdOffset]
560 case matchSum scrutinee left right | matchList scrutinee left right |
561 ite scrutinee left right =>
562 exact ⟨scrutinee.realCoordinates ++ left.realCoordinates, by simp,
563 by rw [List.length_append, realCoordinates_length, realCoordinates_length]⟩
564
565theorem firstChild_coordinate (expression : Expr) (index : Nat)
566 (inBounds : index < (Expr.firstChild expression).skeleton.realArity) :
567 (Expr.firstChild expression).realCoordinates.getD index 0 =
568 expression.realCoordinates.getD index 0 := by
569 rcases firstChild_coordinates_decompose expression with ⟨suffix, equality⟩
570 rw [equality, List.getD_append]
571 rw [realCoordinates_length]
572 exact inBounds
573
574theorem secondChild_coordinate (expression : Expr) (index : Nat)
575 (inBounds : index < (Expr.secondChild expression).skeleton.realArity) :
576 (Expr.secondChild expression).realCoordinates.getD index 0 =
577 expression.realCoordinates.getD (Skeleton.secondOffset expression.skeleton + index) 0 := by
578 rcases secondChild_coordinates_decompose expression with
579 ⟨front, suffix, equality, frontLength⟩
580 rw [equality, ← frontLength, list_getD_append_middle]
581 rw [realCoordinates_length]
582 exact inBounds
583
584theorem thirdChild_coordinate (expression : Expr) (index : Nat) :
585 (Expr.thirdChild expression).realCoordinates.getD index 0 =
586 expression.realCoordinates.getD (Skeleton.thirdOffset expression.skeleton + index) 0 := by
587 rcases thirdChild_coordinates_decompose expression with ⟨front, equality, frontLength⟩
588 rw [equality, ← frontLength, list_getD_append_right]
589
590namespace MeasurableFamily
591
592def firstChild {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {parent : α → Expr}
593 (family : MeasurableFamily α parent) :
594 MeasurableFamily α (fun parameter => Expr.firstChild (parent parameter)) :=
595 family.extractContiguous (Skeleton.firstChild family.skeleton) 0
596 (fun parameter => by
597 rw [firstChild_skeleton, family.skeleton_eq])
598 (fun parameter index inBounds => by
599 simp only [zero_add]
600 apply firstChild_coordinate
601 rwa [firstChild_skeleton, family.skeleton_eq])
602
603def secondChild {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {parent : α → Expr}
604 (family : MeasurableFamily α parent) :
605 MeasurableFamily α (fun parameter => Expr.secondChild (parent parameter)) :=
606 family.extractContiguous (Skeleton.secondChild family.skeleton)
607 (Skeleton.secondOffset family.skeleton)
608 (fun parameter => by
609 rw [secondChild_skeleton, family.skeleton_eq])
610 (fun parameter index inBounds => by
611 rw [secondChild_coordinate]
612 · rw [family.skeleton_eq]
613 · rwa [secondChild_skeleton, family.skeleton_eq])
614
615def thirdChild {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {parent : α → Expr}
616 (family : MeasurableFamily α parent) :
617 MeasurableFamily α (fun parameter => Expr.thirdChild (parent parameter)) :=
618 family.extractContiguous (Skeleton.thirdChild family.skeleton)
619 (Skeleton.thirdOffset family.skeleton)
620 (fun parameter => by
621 rw [thirdChild_skeleton, family.skeleton_eq])
622 (fun parameter index _ => by
623 rw [thirdChild_coordinate, family.skeleton_eq])
624
625end MeasurableFamily
626
627theorem measurable_code : Measurable code := by
628 rw [measurable_iff_comap_le]
629 rfl
630
631theorem measurable_skeleton : Measurable Expr.skeleton :=
632 measurable_fst.comp measurable_code
633
634theorem measurable_realCoordinates :
635 Measurable fun expression : Expr =>
636 (⟨expression.realCoordinates⟩ : RealCoordinates) :=
637 measurable_snd.comp measurable_code
638
639theorem measurable_realCoordinate (index : Nat) :
640 Measurable fun expression : Expr => expression.realCoordinates.getD index 0 :=
641 (RealCoordinates.measurable_getD index).comp measurable_realCoordinates
642
643theorem measurable_realCoordinateAt {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
644 (coordinates : α → RealCoordinates) (coordinatesMeasurable : Measurable coordinates)
645 (index : α → Nat) (indexMeasurable : Measurable index) :
646 Measurable fun parameter => (coordinates parameter).values.getD (index parameter) 0 := by
647 have indexedGetD : Measurable fun pair : RealCoordinates × Nat =>
648 pair.1.values.getD pair.2 0 :=
649 measurable_from_prod_countable_left fun index =>
650 RealCoordinates.measurable_getD index
651 exact indexedGetD.comp (coordinatesMeasurable.prodMk indexMeasurable)
652
653def realCoordinatesAppend (left right : RealCoordinates) : RealCoordinates :=
654 ⟨left.values ++ right.values⟩
655
656theorem realCoordinatesAppend_measurable :
657 Measurable fun pair : RealCoordinates × RealCoordinates =>
658 realCoordinatesAppend pair.1 pair.2 := by
659 classical
660 have leftLength : Measurable fun pair : RealCoordinates × RealCoordinates =>
661 pair.1.values.length := RealCoordinates.measurable_length.comp measurable_fst
662 have rightLength : Measurable fun pair : RealCoordinates × RealCoordinates =>
663 pair.2.values.length := RealCoordinates.measurable_length.comp measurable_snd
664 have sumMeasurable : Measurable fun pair : RealCoordinates × RealCoordinates =>
665 pair.1.values.length + pair.2.values.length := leftLength.add rightLength
666 have appendLengthMeasurable : Measurable fun pair : RealCoordinates × RealCoordinates =>
667 (realCoordinatesAppend pair.1 pair.2).values.length := by
668 simpa only [realCoordinatesAppend, List.length_append] using sumMeasurable
669 have coordinatesMeasurable (index : Nat) :
670 Measurable fun pair : RealCoordinates × RealCoordinates =>
671 (realCoordinatesAppend pair.1 pair.2).values.getD index 0 := by
672 let region : Set (RealCoordinates × RealCoordinates) :=
673 {pair | index < pair.1.values.length}
674 have regionMeasurable : MeasurableSet region := by
675 exact leftLength measurableSet_Ioi
676 have leftCoordinate : Measurable fun pair : RealCoordinates × RealCoordinates =>
677 pair.1.values.getD index 0 :=
678 (RealCoordinates.measurable_getD index).comp measurable_fst
679 have rightCoordinate : Measurable fun pair : RealCoordinates × RealCoordinates =>
680 pair.2.values.getD (index - pair.1.values.length) 0 :=
681 measurable_realCoordinateAt
682 (fun pair : RealCoordinates × RealCoordinates => pair.2) measurable_snd
683 (fun pair => index - pair.1.values.length)
684 (measurable_const.sub leftLength)
685 have piecewiseMeasurable : Measurable (region.piecewise
686 (fun pair => pair.1.values.getD index 0)
687 (fun pair => pair.2.values.getD (index - pair.1.values.length) 0)) := by
688 exact leftCoordinate.piecewise regionMeasurable rightCoordinate
689 convert piecewiseMeasurable using 1
690 funext pair
691 change (pair.1.values ++ pair.2.values).getD index 0 = _
692 rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_append]
693 by_cases member : index < pair.1.values.length
694 · rw [if_pos member, ← List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
695 simp [region, Set.piecewise, member]
696 · rw [if_neg member, ← List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
697 simp [region, Set.piecewise, member]
698 exact RealCoordinates.measurable_of_length_getD appendLengthMeasurable coordinatesMeasurable
699
700theorem measurable_expr_of_parts {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
701 (expression : α → Expr)
702 (skeletonMeasurable : Measurable fun parameter => (expression parameter).skeleton)
703 (coordinatesMeasurable : Measurable fun parameter =>
704 (⟨(expression parameter).realCoordinates⟩ : RealCoordinates)) :
705 Measurable expression := by
706 rw [measurable_iff_comap_le]
707 change MeasurableSpace.comap expression
708 (MeasurableSpace.comap code (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace Code)) ≤ _
709 rw [MeasurableSpace.comap_comp]
710 apply Measurable.comap_le
711 exact Measurable.prod skeletonMeasurable coordinatesMeasurable
712
713theorem measurable_binaryConstructor {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
714 {left right : α → Expr} (leftMeasurable : Measurable left)
715 (rightMeasurable : Measurable right) (constructor : Expr → Expr → Expr)
716 (skeletonConstructor : Skeleton → Skeleton → Skeleton)
717 (skeleton_rule : ∀ l r, (constructor l r).skeleton =
718 skeletonConstructor l.skeleton r.skeleton)
719 (coordinates_rule : ∀ l r, (constructor l r).realCoordinates =
720 l.realCoordinates ++ r.realCoordinates) :
721 Measurable fun parameter => constructor (left parameter) (right parameter) := by
722 apply measurable_expr_of_parts
723 · have leftSkeleton := measurable_skeleton.comp leftMeasurable
724 have rightSkeleton := measurable_skeleton.comp rightMeasurable
725 have paired : Measurable fun parameter =>
726 ((left parameter).skeleton, (right parameter).skeleton) :=
727 Measurable.prod leftSkeleton rightSkeleton
728 have operation : Measurable fun pair : Skeleton × Skeleton =>
729 skeletonConstructor pair.1 pair.2 := measurable_of_countable _
730 convert operation.comp paired using 1
731 funext parameter
732 simpa using skeleton_rule (left parameter) (right parameter)
733 have leftCoordinates : Measurable fun parameter =>
734 (⟨(left parameter).realCoordinates⟩ : RealCoordinates) :=
735 measurable_realCoordinates.comp leftMeasurable
736 have rightCoordinates : Measurable fun parameter =>
737 (⟨(right parameter).realCoordinates⟩ : RealCoordinates) :=
738 measurable_realCoordinates.comp rightMeasurable
739 have paired : Measurable fun parameter =>
740 ((⟨(left parameter).realCoordinates⟩ : RealCoordinates),
741 (⟨(right parameter).realCoordinates⟩ : RealCoordinates)) :=
742 Measurable.prod leftCoordinates rightCoordinates
743 have appended := realCoordinatesAppend_measurable.comp paired
744 convert appended using 1
745 funext parameter
746 simp [realCoordinatesAppend, coordinates_rule]
747
748theorem measurable_unaryConstructor {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
749 {body : α → Expr} (bodyMeasurable : Measurable body)
750 (constructor : Expr → Expr) (skeletonConstructor : Skeleton → Skeleton)
751 (skeleton_rule : ∀ expression, (constructor expression).skeleton =
752 skeletonConstructor expression.skeleton)
753 (coordinates_rule : ∀ expression, (constructor expression).realCoordinates =
754 expression.realCoordinates) :
755 Measurable fun parameter => constructor (body parameter) := by
756 apply measurable_expr_of_parts
757 · have operation : Measurable fun skeleton : Skeleton => skeletonConstructor skeleton :=
758 measurable_of_countable _
759 convert operation.comp (measurable_skeleton.comp bodyMeasurable) using 1
760 funext parameter
761 simpa using skeleton_rule (body parameter)
762 · convert measurable_realCoordinates.comp bodyMeasurable using 1
763 funext parameter
764 simp [coordinates_rule]
765
766theorem measurable_realLiteral {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
767 {value : α → ℝ} (valueMeasurable : Measurable value) :
768 Measurable fun parameter => Expr.real (value parameter) := by
769 apply measurable_expr_of_parts
770 · simp [Expr.skeleton]
771 · have singletonCoordinates : Measurable fun parameter : α =>
772 (⟨[value parameter]⟩ : RealCoordinates) := by
773 apply RealCoordinates.measurable_of_length_getD
774 · exact measurable_const
775 · intro index
776 cases index with
777 | zero => simpa [List.getD] using valueMeasurable
778 | succ _ =>
779 simp [List.getD]
780 simpa [Expr.realCoordinates] using singletonCoordinates
781
782theorem terminalFloatSet_eq :
783 terminalFloatSet = Expr.skeleton ⁻¹' {Skeleton.real} := by
784 ext expression
785 cases expression <;>
786 simp [terminalFloatSet, Expr.skeleton]
787
788theorem terminalFloatSet_measurable : MeasurableSet terminalFloatSet := by
789 rw [terminalFloatSet_eq]
790 have singletonMeasurable : MeasurableSet ({Skeleton.real} : Set Skeleton) := by
791 change True
792 trivial
793 exact measurable_skeleton singletonMeasurable
794
795theorem terminalFloatValue_measurable : Measurable terminalFloatValue := by
796 classical
797 have piecewiseEq : terminalFloatValue =
798 terminalFloatSet.piecewise
799 (fun expression => expression.realCoordinates.getD 0 0) (fun _ => 0) := by
800 funext expression
801 cases expression <;>
802 simp [Set.piecewise, terminalFloatValue, terminalFloatSet,
803 Expr.realCoordinates, List.getD]
804 rw [piecewiseEq]
805 exact (measurable_realCoordinate 0).piecewise terminalFloatSet_measurable measurable_const
806
807def SkeletonFiber (skeleton : Skeleton) : Set Expr :=
808 {expression | expression.skeleton = skeleton}
809
810theorem skeletonFiber_measurable (skeleton : Skeleton) :
811 MeasurableSet (SkeletonFiber skeleton) := by
812 have singletonMeasurable : MeasurableSet ({skeleton} : Set Skeleton) := by
813 change True
814 trivial
815 have preimageMeasurable := measurable_skeleton singletonMeasurable
816 convert preimageMeasurable using 1
817 ext expression
818 simp [SkeletonFiber]
819
820def MeasurableFamily.skeletonFiber (skeleton : Skeleton) :
821 MeasurableFamily (SkeletonFiber skeleton) Subtype.val where
822 skeleton := skeleton
823 skeleton_eq expression := expression.property
824 coordinate_measurable index :=
825 (measurable_realCoordinate index).comp measurable_subtype_coe
826
827def skeletonShift (amount cutoff : Nat) : Skeleton → Skeleton
828 | .bvar index => .bvar (if cutoff ≤ index then index + amount else index)
829 | .unit => .unit
830 | .reject => .reject
831 | .discrete kind d => .discrete kind (skeletonShift amount cutoff d)
832 | .bool value => .bool value
833 | .real => .real
834 | .lam body => .lam (skeletonShift amount (cutoff + 1) body)
835 | .fix body => .fix (skeletonShift amount (cutoff + 2) body)
836 | .app function argument =>
837 .app (skeletonShift amount cutoff function) (skeletonShift amount cutoff argument)
838 | .pair left right =>
839 .pair (skeletonShift amount cutoff left) (skeletonShift amount cutoff right)
840 | .fst pair => .fst (skeletonShift amount cutoff pair)
841 | .snd pair => .snd (skeletonShift amount cutoff pair)
842 | .inl value => .inl (skeletonShift amount cutoff value)
843 | .inr value => .inr (skeletonShift amount cutoff value)
844 | .matchSum scrutinee left right =>
845 .matchSum (skeletonShift amount cutoff scrutinee)
846 (skeletonShift amount (cutoff + 1) left) (skeletonShift amount (cutoff + 1) right)
847 | .nil => .nil
848 | .cons head tail =>
849 .cons (skeletonShift amount cutoff head) (skeletonShift amount cutoff tail)
850 | .matchList scrutinee nilCase consCase =>
851 .matchList (skeletonShift amount cutoff scrutinee)
852 (skeletonShift amount cutoff nilCase) (skeletonShift amount (cutoff + 2) consCase)
853 | .ite condition thenBranch elseBranch =>
854 .ite (skeletonShift amount cutoff condition) (skeletonShift amount cutoff thenBranch)
855 (skeletonShift amount cutoff elseBranch)
856 | .letE value body =>
857 .letE (skeletonShift amount cutoff value)
858 (skeletonShift amount (cutoff + 1) body)
859 | .neg body => .neg (skeletonShift amount cutoff body)
860 | .add left right =>
861 .add (skeletonShift amount cutoff left) (skeletonShift amount cutoff right)
862 | .mul left right =>
863 .mul (skeletonShift amount cutoff left) (skeletonShift amount cutoff right)
864 | .div left right =>
865 .div (skeletonShift amount cutoff left) (skeletonShift amount cutoff right)
866 | .lt left right => .lt (skeletonShift amount cutoff left) (skeletonShift amount cutoff right)
867 | .uniform kind left right =>
868 .uniform kind (skeletonShift amount cutoff left) (skeletonShift amount cutoff right)
869 | .gaussian kind left right =>
870 .gaussian kind (skeletonShift amount cutoff left) (skeletonShift amount cutoff right)
871 | .poisson kind body => .poisson kind (skeletonShift amount cutoff body)
872 | .bernoulli kind body => .bernoulli kind (skeletonShift amount cutoff body)
873 | .exponential kind body => .exponential kind (skeletonShift amount cutoff body)
874 | .beta kind left right =>
875 .beta kind (skeletonShift amount cutoff left) (skeletonShift amount cutoff right)
876 | .gamma kind left right =>
877 .gamma kind (skeletonShift amount cutoff left) (skeletonShift amount cutoff right)
878
879theorem shift_skeleton (amount cutoff : Nat) (expression : Expr) :
880 (expression.shift amount cutoff).skeleton =
881 skeletonShift amount cutoff expression.skeleton := by
882 induction expression generalizing cutoff <;>
883 simp [Expr.shift, Expr.mapVars, Expr.skeleton, skeletonShift, *]
884
885theorem shift_realCoordinates (amount cutoff : Nat) (expression : Expr) :
886 (expression.shift amount cutoff).realCoordinates = expression.realCoordinates := by
887 induction expression generalizing cutoff <;>
888 simp [Expr.shift, Expr.mapVars, Expr.realCoordinates, *]
889
890def MeasurableFamily.shift {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
891 {expression : α → Expr} (family : MeasurableFamily α expression)
892 (amount cutoff : Nat) :
893 MeasurableFamily α (fun parameter => (expression parameter).shift amount cutoff) where
894 skeleton := skeletonShift amount cutoff family.skeleton
895 skeleton_eq parameter := by rw [shift_skeleton, family.skeleton_eq]
896 coordinate_measurable index := by
897 have equality :
898 (fun parameter => ((expression parameter).shift amount cutoff).realCoordinates.getD index 0) =
899 fun parameter => (expression parameter).realCoordinates.getD index 0 := by
900 funext parameter
901 rw [shift_realCoordinates]
902 rw [equality]
903 exact family.coordinate_measurable index
904
905def skeletonSubstAt (depth : Nat) (replacement : Skeleton) : Skeleton → Skeleton
906 | .bvar index => if index = depth then skeletonShift depth 0 replacement
907 else .bvar (if depth < index then index - 1 else index)
908 | .unit => .unit
909 | .reject => .reject
910 | .discrete kind d => .discrete kind (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement d)
911 | .bool value => .bool value
912 | .real => .real
913 | .lam body => .lam (skeletonSubstAt (depth + 1) replacement body)
914 | .fix body =>
915 .fix (skeletonSubstAt (depth + 2) replacement body)
916 | .app function argument => .app
917 (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement function)
918 (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement argument)
919 | .pair left right => .pair
920 (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement left) (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement right)
921 | .fst pair => .fst (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement pair)
922 | .snd pair => .snd (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement pair)
923 | .inl value => .inl (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement value)
924 | .inr value => .inr (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement value)
925 | .matchSum scrutinee left right => .matchSum
926 (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement scrutinee)
927 (skeletonSubstAt (depth + 1) replacement left)
928 (skeletonSubstAt (depth + 1) replacement right)
929 | .nil => .nil
930 | .cons head tail => .cons
931 (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement head) (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement tail)
932 | .matchList scrutinee nilCase consCase => .matchList
933 (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement scrutinee)
934 (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement nilCase)
935 (skeletonSubstAt (depth + 2) replacement consCase)
936 | .ite condition thenBranch elseBranch => .ite
937 (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement condition)
938 (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement thenBranch)
939 (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement elseBranch)
940 | .letE value body => .letE
941 (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement value)
942 (skeletonSubstAt (depth + 1) replacement body)
943 | .neg body => .neg (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement body)
944 | .add left right => .add
945 (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement left) (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement right)
946 | .mul left right => .mul
947 (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement left) (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement right)
948 | .div left right => .div
949 (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement left) (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement right)
950 | .lt left right => .lt
951 (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement left) (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement right)
952 | .uniform kind left right =>
953 .uniform kind (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement left) (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement right)
954 | .gaussian kind left right =>
955 .gaussian kind (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement left) (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement right)
956 | .poisson kind body => .poisson kind (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement body)
957 | .bernoulli kind body => .bernoulli kind (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement body)
958 | .exponential kind body => .exponential kind (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement body)
959 | .beta kind left right =>
960 .beta kind (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement left) (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement right)
961 | .gamma kind left right =>
962 .gamma kind (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement left) (skeletonSubstAt depth replacement right)
963
964theorem substAt_skeleton (depth : Nat) (replacement expression : Expr) :
965 (Expr.substAt depth replacement expression).skeleton =
966 skeletonSubstAt depth replacement.skeleton expression.skeleton := by
967 induction expression generalizing depth with
968 | bvar index =>
969 simp only [Expr.substAt, Expr.mapVars, Expr.skeleton, skeletonSubstAt]
970 split <;> simp [shift_skeleton, Expr.skeleton]
971 | _ => simp [Expr.substAt, Expr.mapVars, Expr.skeleton, skeletonSubstAt, *]
972
973inductive CoordinateSelector where
974 | body (index : Nat)
975 | replacement (index : Nat)
976
977def coordinatePlan (depth : Nat) (replacement : Skeleton) (bodyOffset : Nat) :
978 Skeleton → List CoordinateSelector
979 | .bvar index =>
980 if index = depth then
981 (List.range replacement.realArity).map CoordinateSelector.replacement
982 else []
983 | .real => [.body bodyOffset]
984 | .lam body => coordinatePlan (depth + 1) replacement bodyOffset body
985 | .fix body => coordinatePlan (depth + 2) replacement bodyOffset body
986 | .fst body | .snd body | .inl body | .inr body
987 | .neg body => coordinatePlan depth replacement bodyOffset body
988 | .app left right | .pair left right | .cons left right
989 | .add left right | .mul left right | .div left right | .lt left right =>
990 coordinatePlan depth replacement bodyOffset left ++
991 coordinatePlan depth replacement (bodyOffset + left.realArity) right
992 | .matchSum scrutinee left right =>
993 coordinatePlan depth replacement bodyOffset scrutinee ++
994 coordinatePlan (depth + 1) replacement
995 (bodyOffset + scrutinee.realArity) left ++
996 coordinatePlan (depth + 1) replacement
997 (bodyOffset + scrutinee.realArity + left.realArity) right
998 | .matchList scrutinee nilCase consCase =>
999 coordinatePlan depth replacement bodyOffset scrutinee ++
1000 coordinatePlan depth replacement
1001 (bodyOffset + scrutinee.realArity) nilCase ++
1002 coordinatePlan (depth + 2) replacement
1003 (bodyOffset + scrutinee.realArity + nilCase.realArity) consCase
1004 | .ite condition thenBranch elseBranch =>
1005 coordinatePlan depth replacement bodyOffset condition ++
1006 coordinatePlan depth replacement
1007 (bodyOffset + condition.realArity) thenBranch ++
1008 coordinatePlan depth replacement
1009 (bodyOffset + condition.realArity + thenBranch.realArity) elseBranch
1010 | .letE value body =>
1011 coordinatePlan depth replacement bodyOffset value ++
1012 coordinatePlan (depth + 1) replacement
1013 (bodyOffset + value.realArity) body
1014 | .uniform _ left right | .gaussian _ left right | .beta _ left right
1015 | .gamma _ left right =>
1016 coordinatePlan depth replacement bodyOffset left ++
1017 coordinatePlan depth replacement (bodyOffset + left.realArity) right
1018 | .poisson _ body | .bernoulli _ body | .exponential _ body | .discrete _ body => coordinatePlan depth replacement bodyOffset body
1019 | _ => []
1020
1021def CoordinateSelector.eval (body replacement : List ℝ) : CoordinateSelector → ℝ
1022 | .body index => body.getD index 0
1023 | .replacement index => replacement.getD index 0
1024
1025def applyCoordinatePlan (plan : List CoordinateSelector)
1026 (body replacement : List ℝ) : List ℝ :=
1027 plan.map (CoordinateSelector.eval body replacement)
1028
1029theorem map_range_getD (values : List ℝ) :
1030 (List.range values.length).map (fun index => values.getD index 0) = values := by
1031 apply List.ext_getElem
1032 · simp
1033 · intro index leftBounds rightBounds
1034 simp [List.getD, rightBounds]

1036theorem applyCoordinatePlan_replacementRange (body replacement : List ℝ) :
1037 applyCoordinatePlan
1038 ((List.range replacement.length).map CoordinateSelector.replacement)
1039 body replacement = replacement := by
1040 unfold applyCoordinatePlan
1041 rw [List.map_map]
1042 change (List.range replacement.length).map
1043 (fun index => replacement.getD index 0) = replacement
1044 exact map_range_getD replacement
1045
1046@[simp] theorem applyCoordinatePlan_append (left right : List CoordinateSelector)
1047 (body replacement : List ℝ) :
1048 applyCoordinatePlan (left ++ right) body replacement =
1049 applyCoordinatePlan left body replacement ++
1050 applyCoordinatePlan right body replacement := by
1051 simp [applyCoordinatePlan]
1052
1053theorem applyCoordinatePlan_bodyAtPrefix (before suffix : List ℝ) (value : ℝ)
1054 (replacement : List ℝ) :
1055 applyCoordinatePlan [.body before.length] (before ++ value :: suffix) replacement =
1056 [value] := by
1057 simp [applyCoordinatePlan, CoordinateSelector.eval, List.getD]
1058
1059theorem applyCoordinatePlan_coordinatePlan (depth : Nat) (replacement expression : Expr)
1060 (before suffix : List ℝ) :
1061 applyCoordinatePlan
1062 (coordinatePlan depth replacement.skeleton before.length expression.skeleton)
1063 (before ++ expression.realCoordinates ++ suffix) replacement.realCoordinates =
1064 (Expr.substAt depth replacement expression).realCoordinates := by
1065 induction expression generalizing depth before suffix with
1066 | bvar index =>
1067 simp only [coordinatePlan, Expr.substAt, Expr.mapVars, Expr.skeleton, Expr.realCoordinates]
1068 split
1069 · rw [← realCoordinates_length replacement, applyCoordinatePlan_replacementRange]
1070 exact shift_realCoordinates depth 0 replacement |>.symm
1071 · simp [applyCoordinatePlan, Expr.realCoordinates]
1072 | real value =>
1073 simpa [coordinatePlan, Expr.substAt, Expr.mapVars, Expr.skeleton, Expr.realCoordinates]
1074 using applyCoordinatePlan_bodyAtPrefix before suffix value replacement.realCoordinates
1075 | pair left right ihLeft ihRight | app left right ihLeft ihRight
1076 | cons left right ihLeft ihRight | add left right ihLeft ihRight
1077 | mul left right ihLeft ihRight | div left right ihLeft ihRight
1078 | lt left right ihLeft ihRight
1079 | uniform _ left right ihLeft ihRight | gaussian _ left right ihLeft ihRight
1080 | beta _ left right ihLeft ihRight | gamma _ left right ihLeft ihRight =>
1081 simp only [coordinatePlan, Expr.skeleton, Expr.realCoordinates, Expr.substAt, Expr.mapVars,
1082 applyCoordinatePlan_append]
1083 have leftResult := ihLeft depth before (right.realCoordinates ++ suffix)
1084 have rightResult := ihRight depth (before ++ left.realCoordinates) suffix
1085 simp only [List.append_assoc] at leftResult rightResult ⊢
1086 rw [leftResult]
1087 have offsetEquality : before.length + left.skeleton.realArity =
1088 (before ++ left.realCoordinates).length := by
1089 rw [List.length_append, realCoordinates_length left]
1090 rw [offsetEquality, rightResult]
1091 | letE value body ihValue ihBody =>
1092 simp only [coordinatePlan, Expr.skeleton, Expr.realCoordinates, Expr.substAt, Expr.mapVars,
1093 applyCoordinatePlan_append]
1094 have valueResult := ihValue depth before (body.realCoordinates ++ suffix)
1095 have bodyResult := ihBody (depth + 1) (before ++ value.realCoordinates) suffix
1096 simp only [List.append_assoc] at valueResult bodyResult ⊢
1097 rw [valueResult]
1098 have offsetEquality : before.length + value.skeleton.realArity =
1099 (before ++ value.realCoordinates).length := by
1100 rw [List.length_append, realCoordinates_length value]
1101 rw [offsetEquality, bodyResult]
1102 | matchSum scrutinee left right ihScrutinee ihLeft ihRight =>
1103 simp only [coordinatePlan, Expr.skeleton, Expr.realCoordinates, Expr.substAt, Expr.mapVars,
1104 applyCoordinatePlan_append]
1105 have scrutineeResult := ihScrutinee depth before
1106 (left.realCoordinates ++ right.realCoordinates ++ suffix)
1107 have leftResult := ihLeft (depth + 1) (before ++ scrutinee.realCoordinates)
1108 (right.realCoordinates ++ suffix)
1109 have rightResult := ihRight (depth + 1)
1110 (before ++ scrutinee.realCoordinates ++ left.realCoordinates) suffix
1111 simp only [List.append_assoc] at scrutineeResult leftResult rightResult ⊢
1112 rw [scrutineeResult]
1113 have firstOffset : before.length + scrutinee.skeleton.realArity =
1114 (before ++ scrutinee.realCoordinates).length := by
1115 rw [List.length_append, realCoordinates_length scrutinee]
1116 rw [firstOffset, leftResult]
1117 have secondOffset : (before ++ scrutinee.realCoordinates).length +
1118 left.skeleton.realArity =
1119 (before ++ (scrutinee.realCoordinates ++ left.realCoordinates)).length := by
1120 simp only [List.length_append]
1121 rw [realCoordinates_length left]
1122 omega
1123 rw [secondOffset, rightResult]
1124 | matchList scrutinee nilCase consCase ihScrutinee ihNil ihCons =>
1125 simp only [coordinatePlan, Expr.skeleton, Expr.realCoordinates, Expr.substAt, Expr.mapVars,
1126 applyCoordinatePlan_append]
1127 have scrutineeResult := ihScrutinee depth before
1128 (nilCase.realCoordinates ++ consCase.realCoordinates ++ suffix)
1129 have nilResult := ihNil depth (before ++ scrutinee.realCoordinates)
1130 (consCase.realCoordinates ++ suffix)
1131 have consResult := ihCons (depth + 2)
1132 (before ++ scrutinee.realCoordinates ++ nilCase.realCoordinates) suffix
1133 simp only [List.append_assoc] at scrutineeResult nilResult consResult ⊢
1134 rw [scrutineeResult]
1135 have firstOffset : before.length + scrutinee.skeleton.realArity =
1136 (before ++ scrutinee.realCoordinates).length := by
1137 rw [List.length_append, realCoordinates_length scrutinee]
1138 rw [firstOffset, nilResult]
1139 have secondOffset : (before ++ scrutinee.realCoordinates).length +
1140 nilCase.skeleton.realArity =
1141 (before ++ (scrutinee.realCoordinates ++ nilCase.realCoordinates)).length := by
1142 simp only [List.length_append]
1143 rw [realCoordinates_length nilCase]
1144 omega
1145 rw [secondOffset, consResult]
1146 | ite condition thenBranch elseBranch ihCondition ihThen ihElse =>
1147 simp only [coordinatePlan, Expr.skeleton, Expr.realCoordinates, Expr.substAt, Expr.mapVars,
1148 applyCoordinatePlan_append]
1149 have conditionResult := ihCondition depth before
1150 (thenBranch.realCoordinates ++ elseBranch.realCoordinates ++ suffix)
1151 have thenResult := ihThen depth (before ++ condition.realCoordinates)
1152 (elseBranch.realCoordinates ++ suffix)
1153 have elseResult := ihElse depth
1154 (before ++ condition.realCoordinates ++ thenBranch.realCoordinates) suffix
1155 simp only [List.append_assoc] at conditionResult thenResult elseResult ⊢
1156 rw [conditionResult]
1157 have firstOffset : before.length + condition.skeleton.realArity =
1158 (before ++ condition.realCoordinates).length := by
1159 rw [List.length_append, realCoordinates_length condition]
1160 rw [firstOffset, thenResult]
1161 have secondOffset : (before ++ condition.realCoordinates).length +
1162 thenBranch.skeleton.realArity =
1163 (before ++ (condition.realCoordinates ++ thenBranch.realCoordinates)).length := by
1164 simp only [List.length_append]
1165 rw [realCoordinates_length thenBranch]
1166 omega
1167 rw [secondOffset, elseResult]
1168 | lam body ih =>
1169 simpa only [coordinatePlan, Expr.skeleton, Expr.realCoordinates, Expr.substAt,
1170 Expr.mapVars] using ih (depth + 1) before suffix
1171 | fix body ih =>
1172 simpa only [coordinatePlan, Expr.skeleton, Expr.realCoordinates, Expr.substAt,
1173 Expr.mapVars] using ih (depth + 2) before suffix
1174 | fst body ih | snd body ih | inl body ih | inr body ih
1175 | neg body ih
1176 | poisson _ body ih | exponential _ body ih | bernoulli _ body ih | discrete _ body ih
1177 =>
1178 simpa only [coordinatePlan, Expr.skeleton, Expr.realCoordinates, Expr.substAt,
1179 Expr.mapVars] using ih depth before suffix
1180 | unit | reject | bool flag | nil =>
1181 simp [coordinatePlan, Expr.skeleton, Expr.realCoordinates, Expr.substAt, Expr.mapVars,
1182 applyCoordinatePlan]

1184theorem substAt_realCoordinates (depth : Nat) (replacement expression : Expr) :
1185 applyCoordinatePlan
1186 (coordinatePlan depth replacement.skeleton 0 expression.skeleton)
1187 expression.realCoordinates replacement.realCoordinates =
1188 (Expr.substAt depth replacement expression).realCoordinates := by
1189 simpa using
1190 applyCoordinatePlan_coordinatePlan depth replacement expression [] []

1194 (applyCoordinatePlan plan body replacement).getD index 0 =

1198def MeasurableFamily.substAt {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
1199 {body replacement : α → Expr} (bodyFamily : MeasurableFamily α body)
1200 (depth : Nat) (replacementFamily : MeasurableFamily α replacement) :
1201 MeasurableFamily α
1202 (fun parameter => Expr.substAt depth (replacement parameter) (body parameter)) where
1203 skeleton := skeletonSubstAt depth replacementFamily.skeleton bodyFamily.skeleton
1204 skeleton_eq parameter := by
1205 rw [substAt_skeleton, replacementFamily.skeleton_eq, bodyFamily.skeleton_eq]
1206 coordinate_measurable index := by
1207 let plan := coordinatePlan depth replacementFamily.skeleton 0 bodyFamily.skeleton
1208 have coordinateEquality (parameter : α) :
1209 (Expr.substAt depth (replacement parameter) (body parameter)).realCoordinates =
1210 applyCoordinatePlan plan (body parameter).realCoordinates
1211 (replacement parameter).realCoordinates := by
1212 rw [← substAt_realCoordinates]
1213 simp only [plan, replacementFamily.skeleton_eq, bodyFamily.skeleton_eq]
1214 by_cases inBounds : index < plan.length
1215 · let selector := plan[index]
1216 have functionEquality :
1217 (fun parameter =>
1218 (Expr.substAt depth (replacement parameter) (body parameter)).realCoordinates.getD
1219 index 0) =
1220 fun parameter => selector.eval (body parameter).realCoordinates
1221 (replacement parameter).realCoordinates := by
1222 funext parameter
1223 rw [coordinateEquality parameter]
1224 exact applyCoordinatePlan_getD_of_lt _ _ _ index inBounds
1225 rw [functionEquality]
1226 cases selector with
1227 | body bodyIndex => exact bodyFamily.coordinate_measurable bodyIndex
1228 | replacement replacementIndex =>
1229 exact replacementFamily.coordinate_measurable replacementIndex
1230 · have functionEquality :
1231 (fun parameter =>
1232 (Expr.substAt depth (replacement parameter) (body parameter)).realCoordinates.getD
1233 index 0) = fun _ => 0 := by
1234 funext parameter
1235 rw [coordinateEquality parameter]
1236 simp [applyCoordinatePlan, List.getD, inBounds]
1237 rw [functionEquality]
1238 exact measurable_const

1257theorem isValue_eq_skeletonIsValue : ∀ expression : Expr,
1258 expression.isValue = Expr.isValue expression.skeleton
1259 | .bvar _ | .reject | .discrete _ _ | .unit | .bool _ | .real _ | .lam _ | .fix _
1260 | .app _ _ | .fst _ | .snd _ | .matchSum _ _ _ | .nil
1261 | .matchList _ _ _ | .ite _ _ _ | .letE _ _
1262 | .neg _ | .add _ _ | .mul _ _ | .div _ _ | .lt _ _ => by
1263 simp [Expr.isValue, Expr.skeleton, Expr.isValue]

1278def paramsFromCoordinates (op : Determinize.Spec.Paper.Op)
1279 (affine general : List ℝ) : Determinize.Spec.Paper.Params op :=
1280 (fun index => affine.getD index.1 0, fun index => general.getD index.1 0)

1282theorem paramsFromCoordinates_eq_getElem
1283 (op : Determinize.Spec.Paper.Op) (affine general : List ℝ)
1284 (affineArity : affine.length =
1285 Determinize.Spec.Paper.affineArity op)
1286 (generalArity : general.length =
1287 Determinize.Spec.Paper.generalArity op) :
1288 paramsFromCoordinates op affine general =
1289 (fun index => affine[index.1]'(by simp [affineArity]),
1290 fun index => general[index.1]'(by simp [generalArity])) := by

1299theorem measurable_meanValue (op : Determinize.Spec.Paper.Op) :
1300 Measurable (Determinize.Spec.Paper.meanValue op) := by
1301 cases op <;> unfold Determinize.Spec.Paper.meanValue <;> fun_prop
1302
1303/-- The kernel of a primitive site in its evaluated parameters: the primitive's law at a
1304stochastic site, the Dirac mass at its mean on the parameter domain at a mean site. -/
1305noncomputable def primitiveKernelPack
1306 (laws : Determinize.Proof.Paper.PrimitiveLaws) :
1307 (kind : DistributionAction) → (op : Op) → SFiniteKernel (Determinize.Spec.Paper.Params op) ℝ
1308 | .sample _, op => ⟨laws.kernel op, laws.kernel_sfinite op⟩
1309 | .mean, op => SFiniteKernel.piecewise
1310 (Determinize.Proof.Paper.measurableSet_domain op)
1311 (SFiniteKernel.deterministic
1312 (Determinize.Spec.Paper.meanValue op) (measurable_meanValue op))
1313 SFiniteKernel.zero
1314
1315theorem primitiveFiber_eq_atomic
1316 (laws : Determinize.Proof.Paper.PrimitiveLaws) (kind : DistributionAction) (op : Op)
1317 (affine general : List ℝ)
1318 (affineArity : affine.length =
1319 Determinize.Spec.Paper.affineArity op)
1320 (generalArity : general.length =
1321 Determinize.Spec.Paper.generalArity op) :
1322 primitiveFiber kind op affine general =
1323 (primitiveKernelPack laws kind op).kernel (paramsFromCoordinates op affine general) := by
1324 classical
1325 cases kind with
1326 | sample affinity =>
1327 simp only [primitiveKernelPack]
1328 unfold primitiveFiber
1329 Determinize.Spec.Paper.parseParams
1330 simp only
1331 rw [dif_pos affineArity, dif_pos generalArity]
1332 rw [laws.kernel_eq_paperMeasure]
1333 apply congrArg (Determinize.Spec.Paper.paperMeasure op)
1334 exact (paramsFromCoordinates_eq_getElem op affine general
1335 affineArity generalArity).symm
1336 | mean =>
1337 simp only [primitiveKernelPack]
1338 unfold primitiveFiber
1339 Determinize.Spec.Paper.parseParams
1340 simp only
1341 rw [dif_pos affineArity, dif_pos generalArity]
1342 let actualParams : Determinize.Spec.Paper.Params op :=
1343 (fun index => affine[index.1]'(by simp [affineArity]),
1344 fun index => general[index.1]'(by simp [generalArity]))
1345 have actualParamsEquality : actualParams =
1346 paramsFromCoordinates op affine general := by
1347 dsimp only [actualParams]
1348 exact (paramsFromCoordinates_eq_getElem op affine general
1349 affineArity generalArity).symm
1350 change (if Determinize.Spec.Paper.domain op actualParams then
1351 Measure.dirac (Determinize.Spec.Paper.meanValue op actualParams)
1352 else 0) =
1353 (SFiniteKernel.piecewise
1354 (Determinize.Proof.Paper.measurableSet_domain op)
1355 (SFiniteKernel.deterministic
1356 (Determinize.Spec.Paper.meanValue op)
1357 (measurable_meanValue op))
1358 SFiniteKernel.zero).kernel (paramsFromCoordinates op affine general)
1359 unfold SFiniteKernel.piecewise SFiniteKernel.deterministic SFiniteKernel.zero
1360 rw [Kernel.piecewise_apply]
1361 simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
1362 by_cases paramsDomain : Determinize.Spec.Paper.domain op
1363 (paramsFromCoordinates op affine general)
1364 · have actualDomain : Determinize.Spec.Paper.domain op actualParams :=
1365 actualParamsEquality.symm ▸ paramsDomain
1366 rw [if_pos paramsDomain, if_pos actualDomain, Kernel.deterministic_apply]
1367 exact congrArg Measure.dirac
1368 (congrArg (Determinize.Spec.Paper.meanValue op)
1369 actualParamsEquality)
1370 · have actualOutside : ¬ Determinize.Spec.Paper.domain op actualParams :=
1371 fun actualDomain => paramsDomain (actualParamsEquality ▸ actualDomain)
1372 rw [if_neg paramsDomain, if_neg actualOutside]
1373 simp
1374
1375universe u

1377/-- A measurable finite-piece description of a parameter-dependent reduction
1378action. Sample continuations are jointly measurable in the original parameter and
1379the freshly drawn real. -/
1380inductive MeasurableActionFamily (α : Type u) [MeasurableSpace α] :
1381 (α → Action) → Type (u + 1)
1382 | next {successor : α → Expr} (measurable : Measurable successor) :
1383 MeasurableActionFamily α (fun parameter => .next (successor parameter))
1384 | sample {site : DistributionAction × Op} (draw : SFiniteKernel α ℝ)
1385 {continuation : α × ℝ → Expr}
1386 (measurable : Measurable continuation) :
1387 MeasurableActionFamily α (fun parameter =>
1388 .sample site (draw.kernel parameter) (fun value => continuation (parameter, value)))
1389 | stuck : MeasurableActionFamily α (fun _ => .stuck)
1390 | piecewise {region : Set α} [DecidablePred (· ∈ region)]
1391 (measurableRegion : MeasurableSet region)
1392 {whenTrue whenFalse : α → Action}
1393 (trueFamily : MeasurableActionFamily α whenTrue)
1394 (falseFamily : MeasurableActionFamily α whenFalse) :
1395 MeasurableActionFamily α (region.piecewise whenTrue whenFalse)
1396
1397namespace MeasurableActionFamily

1399theorem pullback_apply {α β γ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
1400 [MeasurableSpace γ]
1401 (draw : SFiniteKernel β γ)
1402 (function : α → β) (measurableFunction : Measurable function) (parameter : α) :
1403 (SFiniteKernel.pullback draw function
1404 measurableFunction).kernel parameter = draw.kernel (function parameter) := by
1405 unfold SFiniteKernel.pullback
1406 rw [Kernel.comp_apply]
1407 simp only [Kernel.deterministic_apply]
1408 exact Measure.dirac_bind draw.kernel.measurable _
1409
1410def congr {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {first second : α → Action}
1411 (family : MeasurableActionFamily α first) (equal : first = second) :
1412 MeasurableActionFamily α second := equal ▸ family
1413
1414def comp {α β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
1415 {action : α → Action} (family : MeasurableActionFamily α action)
1416 (function : β → α) (measurableFunction : Measurable function) :
1417 MeasurableActionFamily β (action ∘ function) := by
1418 induction family with
1419 | next successorMeasurable =>
1420 exact .next (successorMeasurable.comp measurableFunction)
1421 | sample draw continuationMeasurable =>
1422 let pulled : SFiniteKernel β ℝ :=
1423 SFiniteKernel.pullback draw function measurableFunction
1424 have firstMeasurable : Measurable (fun pair : β × ℝ => pair.1) := measurable_fst
1425 have secondMeasurable : Measurable (fun pair : β × ℝ => pair.2) := measurable_snd
1426 have pairMeasurable : Measurable (fun pair : β × ℝ => (function pair.1, pair.2)) :=
1427 Measurable.prod (measurableFunction.comp firstMeasurable) secondMeasurable
1428 apply congr (.sample pulled <| continuationMeasurable.comp pairMeasurable)
1429 funext parameter
1430 rw [pullback_apply]
1431 rfl
1432 | stuck => exact .stuck
1433 | @piecewise region _ measurableRegion whenTrue whenFalse trueFamily falseFamily
1434 trueResult falseResult =>
1435 classical
1436 apply congr (.piecewise (measurableRegion.preimage measurableFunction)
1437 trueResult falseResult)
1438 funext parameter
1439 by_cases member : function parameter ∈ region <;>

1442/-- Map every successor and sample continuation through a jointly measurable
1443parameter-dependent one-hole context. -/
1444def map {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {action : α → Action}
1445 (family : MeasurableActionFamily α action) (context : α → Expr → Expr)
1446 (nextMeasurable : ∀ {body : α → Expr}, Measurable body →
1447 Measurable fun input => context input (body input))
1448 (sampleMeasurable : ∀ {body : α × ℝ → Expr}, Measurable body →
1449 Measurable fun input => context input.1 (body input)) :
1450 MeasurableActionFamily α (fun parameter => (action parameter).wrap (context parameter)) := by
1451 induction family with
1452 | next successorIsMeasurable =>
1453 exact .next (nextMeasurable successorIsMeasurable)
1454 | sample draw continuationIsMeasurable =>
1455 exact .sample draw (sampleMeasurable continuationIsMeasurable)
1456 | stuck => exact .stuck
1457 | @piecewise region _ measurableRegion whenTrue whenFalse trueFamily falseFamily
1458 trueResult falseResult =>
1459 classical
1460 apply congr (.piecewise measurableRegion trueResult falseResult)
1461 funext parameter
1462 by_cases member : parameter ∈ region <;>
1463 simp [Set.piecewise, member]

1647theorem measurableTernaryConstructor {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
1648 {first second third : α → Expr} (firstMeasurable : Measurable first)
1649 (secondMeasurable : Measurable second) (thirdMeasurable : Measurable third)
1650 (constructor : Expr → Expr → Expr → Expr)
1651 (skeletonConstructor : Skeleton → Skeleton → Skeleton → Skeleton)
1652 (skeleton_rule : ∀ first second third,
1653 (constructor first second third).skeleton =
1654 skeletonConstructor first.skeleton second.skeleton third.skeleton)
1655 (coordinates_rule : ∀ first second third,
1656 (constructor first second third).realCoordinates =
1657 first.realCoordinates ++ second.realCoordinates ++ third.realCoordinates) :
1658 Measurable fun parameter =>
1659 constructor (first parameter) (second parameter) (third parameter) := by
1660 apply measurable_expr_of_parts
1661 · have inputs : Measurable fun parameter =>
1662 ((first parameter).skeleton, (second parameter).skeleton,
1663 (third parameter).skeleton) :=
1664 Measurable.prod (measurable_skeleton.comp firstMeasurable)
1665 (Measurable.prod (measurable_skeleton.comp secondMeasurable)
1666 (measurable_skeleton.comp thirdMeasurable))
1667 have operation : Measurable fun input : Skeleton × Skeleton × Skeleton =>
1668 skeletonConstructor input.1 input.2.1 input.2.2 := measurable_of_countable _
1669 convert operation.comp inputs using 1
1670 funext parameter
1671 exact skeleton_rule _ _ _
1672 · have firstCoordinates : Measurable fun parameter =>
1673 (⟨(first parameter).realCoordinates⟩ : RealCoordinates) :=
1674 measurable_realCoordinates.comp firstMeasurable
1675 have secondCoordinates : Measurable fun parameter =>
1676 (⟨(second parameter).realCoordinates⟩ : RealCoordinates) :=
1677 measurable_realCoordinates.comp secondMeasurable
1678 have thirdCoordinates : Measurable fun parameter =>
1679 (⟨(third parameter).realCoordinates⟩ : RealCoordinates) :=
1680 measurable_realCoordinates.comp thirdMeasurable
1681 have firstPair : Measurable fun parameter =>
1682 ((⟨(first parameter).realCoordinates⟩ : RealCoordinates),
1683 (⟨(second parameter).realCoordinates⟩ : RealCoordinates)) :=
1684 Measurable.prod firstCoordinates secondCoordinates
1685 have firstTwo : Measurable fun parameter =>
1686 realCoordinatesAppend
1687 (⟨(first parameter).realCoordinates⟩ : RealCoordinates)
1688 (⟨(second parameter).realCoordinates⟩ : RealCoordinates) :=
1689 realCoordinatesAppend_measurable.comp firstPair
1690 have allPair : Measurable fun parameter =>
1691 (realCoordinatesAppend
1692 (⟨(first parameter).realCoordinates⟩ : RealCoordinates)
1693 (⟨(second parameter).realCoordinates⟩ : RealCoordinates),
1694 (⟨(third parameter).realCoordinates⟩ : RealCoordinates)) :=
1695 Measurable.prod firstTwo thirdCoordinates
1696 have allThree := realCoordinatesAppend_measurable.comp allPair
1697 convert allThree using 1
1698 funext parameter
1699 simp [realCoordinatesAppend, coordinates_rule]

1809theorem reduce_app_eq
1810 (function argument : Expr) :
1811 reduce (.app function argument) =
1812 if function.isValue then
1813 if argument.isValue then
1814 match function with
1815 | .lam body => .next (body.substHead argument)
1816 | fix@(.fix body) => .next (body.substTwo argument fix)
1817 | _ => .stuck
1818 else (reduce argument).wrap (fun next => .app function next)
1819 else (reduce function).wrap (fun next => .app next argument) := by
1820 cases function <;> simp only [reduce, Determinize.Spec.Paper.reduce]

3412 (childReduce family.firstChild leftSmaller)
3413 (childReduce family.secondChild rightSmaller))

3418 simp_all [-Determinize.Spec.Paper.reduce, Expr.skeleton, Expr.firstChild, Expr.secondChild]
3419 | gamma kind leftSkeleton rightSkeleton =>
3420 have leftSmaller : sizeOf family.firstChild.skeleton < size := by
3421 rw [← sizeEq, skeletonEq]
3422 simp_all [Skeleton.firstChild]
3423 omega
3424 have rightSmaller : sizeOf family.secondChild.skeleton < size := by
3425 rw [← sizeEq, skeletonEq]
3426 simp_all [Skeleton.firstChild, Skeleton.secondChild]
3427 omega
3428 apply congr (reduceGamma laws kind family.firstChild family.secondChild
3429 (childReduce family.firstChild leftSmaller)
3430 (childReduce family.secondChild rightSmaller))
3431 funext parameter
3432 have fixed := family.skeleton_eq parameter
3433 rw [skeletonEq] at fixed
3434 cases actualEq : expression parameter <;>
3435 simp_all [-Determinize.Spec.Paper.reduce, Expr.skeleton, Expr.firstChild, Expr.secondChild]
3436 | poisson kind bodySkeleton =>
3437 have bodySmaller : sizeOf family.firstChild.skeleton < size := by
3438 rw [← sizeEq, skeletonEq]
3439 simp_all [Skeleton.firstChild]
3440 omega
3441 apply congr (reducePoisson laws kind family.firstChild
3442 (childReduce family.firstChild bodySmaller))
3443 funext parameter
3444 have fixed := family.skeleton_eq parameter
3445 rw [skeletonEq] at fixed
3446 cases actualEq : expression parameter <;>
3447 simp_all [-Determinize.Spec.Paper.reduce, Expr.skeleton, Expr.firstChild]
3448 | bernoulli kind bodySkeleton =>
3449 have bodySmaller : sizeOf family.firstChild.skeleton < size := by
3450 rw [← sizeEq, skeletonEq]
3451 simp_all [Skeleton.firstChild]
3452 omega
3453 apply congr (reduceBernoulli laws kind family.firstChild
3454 (childReduce family.firstChild bodySmaller))
3455 funext parameter
3456 have fixed := family.skeleton_eq parameter
3457 rw [skeletonEq] at fixed
3458 cases actualEq : expression parameter <;>
3459 simp_all [-Determinize.Spec.Paper.reduce, Expr.skeleton, Expr.firstChild]
3460 | exponential kind bodySkeleton =>
3461 have bodySmaller : sizeOf family.firstChild.skeleton < size := by
3462 rw [← sizeEq, skeletonEq]
3463 simp_all [Skeleton.firstChild]
3464 omega
3465 apply congr (reduceExponential laws kind family.firstChild

3472noncomputable def reduceFamily {α : Type u} [MeasurableSpace α]
3473 (laws : Determinize.Proof.Paper.PrimitiveLaws)
3474 {expression : α → Expr} (family : MeasurableFamily α expression) :
3475 MeasurableActionFamily α (fun parameter => reduce (expression parameter)) :=
3476 reduceFamilyAux laws (sizeOf family.skeleton) family rfl

3478noncomputable def kernel {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {action : α → Action}
3479 (family : MeasurableActionFamily α action) :
3480 SFiniteKernel α Expr := by
3481 induction family with
3482 | next successorMeasurable =>
3483 exact SFiniteKernel.deterministic _
3484 successorMeasurable
3485 | sample draw continuationMeasurable =>
3486 exact SFiniteKernel.mapWithInput draw _
3487 continuationMeasurable
3488 | stuck => exact SFiniteKernel.zero
3489 | @piecewise region _ measurableRegion whenTrue whenFalse trueFamily falseFamily
3490 trueKernel falseKernel =>
3491 exact SFiniteKernel.piecewise
3492 measurableRegion trueKernel falseKernel
3493
3494theorem kernel_apply {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {action : α → Action}
3495 (family : MeasurableActionFamily α action) (parameter : α) :
3496 family.kernel.kernel parameter =
3497 match action parameter with
3498 | .next successor => Measure.dirac successor
3499 | .sample _site fiber continuation => fiber.map continuation
3500 | .stuck => 0 := by
3501 induction family with
3502 | @next successor successorMeasurable =>
3503 simp only [kernel, SFiniteKernel.deterministic,
3504 Kernel.deterministic_apply]
3505 | @sample site draw continuation hContinuation =>
3506 let _ := draw.sfinite
3507 ext set measurableSet
3508 unfold kernel SFiniteKernel.mapWithInput
3509 rw [Kernel.map_apply' _ measurable_snd _ measurableSet]
3510 rw [Kernel.compProd_apply (measurable_snd measurableSet)]
3511 have sectionMeasurable : Measurable fun value : ℝ =>
3512 continuation (parameter, value) :=
3513 hContinuation.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)
3514 rw [Measure.map_apply sectionMeasurable measurableSet]
3515 simp only [Kernel.deterministic_apply]
3516 change (∫⁻ value, (Measure.dirac (continuation (parameter, value))) set
3517 ∂draw.kernel parameter) =
3518 draw.kernel parameter
3519 ((fun value => continuation (parameter, value)) ⁻¹' set)
3520 simp_rw [Measure.dirac_apply' _ measurableSet]
3521 exact lintegral_indicator_one (sectionMeasurable measurableSet)
3522 | stuck => rfl
3523 | @piecewise region _ measurableRegion whenTrue whenFalse trueFamily falseFamily
3524 trueApply falseApply =>
3525 classical
3526 by_cases member : parameter ∈ region
3527 · simp only [kernel, SFiniteKernel.piecewise,
3528 Kernel.piecewise_apply, if_pos member]
3529 simp only [Set.piecewise, member]
3530 change trueFamily.kernel.kernel parameter = _
3531 exact trueApply
3532 · simp only [kernel, SFiniteKernel.piecewise,
3533 Kernel.piecewise_apply, if_neg member]
3534 simp only [Set.piecewise, member]
3535 change falseFamily.kernel.kernel parameter = _
3536 exact falseApply

3538noncomputable def toSkeletonFiber (skeleton : Skeleton) (expression : Expr) :
3539 SkeletonFiber skeleton := by
3540 classical
3541 let base := (SkeletonFiber skeleton).piecewise id (fun _ => zeroFill skeleton)
3542 refine ⟨base expression, ?_⟩
3543 by_cases member : expression ∈ SkeletonFiber skeleton
3544 · simp [base, member]
3545 · have different : expression.skeleton ≠ skeleton := by
3546 simpa [SkeletonFiber] using member
3547 simp [base, Set.piecewise, different, SkeletonFiber]

3549@[simp] theorem toSkeletonFiber_coe_of_mem (skeleton : Skeleton) (expression : Expr)
3550 (member : expression ∈ SkeletonFiber skeleton) :
3551 (toSkeletonFiber skeleton expression : Expr) = expression := by
3552 classical
3553 simp [toSkeletonFiber, Set.piecewise, member]
