3555theorem measurable_toSkeletonFiber (skeleton : Skeleton) :
3556 Measurable (toSkeletonFiber skeleton) := by
3557 classical
3558 let base : Expr → Expr := (SkeletonFiber skeleton).piecewise id (fun _ => zeroFill skeleton)
3559 have baseMeasurable : Measurable base :=
3560 measurable_id.piecewise (skeletonFiber_measurable skeleton) measurable_const
3561 have baseFixed : ∀ expression, base expression ∈ SkeletonFiber skeleton := by
3562 intro expression
3563 by_cases member : expression ∈ SkeletonFiber skeleton
3564 · simp [base, member]
3565 · have different : expression.skeleton ≠ skeleton := by
3566 simpa [SkeletonFiber] using member
3567 simp [base, Set.piecewise, different, SkeletonFiber]
3568 have lifted : Measurable fun expression =>
3569 (⟨base expression, baseFixed expression⟩ : SkeletonFiber skeleton) :=
3570 Measurable.subtype_mk baseMeasurable
3571 have equality : toSkeletonFiber skeleton = fun expression =>
3572 (⟨base expression, baseFixed expression⟩ : SkeletonFiber skeleton) := by
3573 funext expression
3574 apply Subtype.ext
3575 rfl
3576 rw [equality]
3577 exact lifted

3579noncomputable def skeletonKernel
3580 (laws : Determinize.Proof.Paper.PrimitiveLaws)
3581 (skeleton : Skeleton) : Kernel Expr Expr := by
3582 classical

3584 let localKernel := actionFamily.kernel
3585 let pulled := localKernel.kernel.comap (toSkeletonFiber skeleton)
3586 (measurable_toSkeletonFiber skeleton)
3587 exact Kernel.piecewise (skeletonFiber_measurable skeleton) pulled 0

3624theorem globalKernel_apply
3625 (laws : Determinize.Proof.Paper.PrimitiveLaws)
3626 (expression : Expr) :
3627 globalKernel laws expression = stepMeasure expression := by

3681theorem stepMeasure_mass_le_one

3726noncomputable def exactOutputKernelPack
3727 (stepKernel : StepKernel) : Nat →
3728 SFiniteKernel Expr ℝ
3729 | 0 => SFiniteKernel.piecewise
3730 terminalFloatSet_measurable
3731 (SFiniteKernel.deterministic
3732 terminalFloatValue terminalFloatValue_measurable)
3733 SFiniteKernel.zero
3734 | depth + 1 => by
3735 let previous := exactOutputKernelPack stepKernel depth
3736 letI := stepKernel.kernel_sfinite
3737 letI := previous.sfinite
3738 let composed : SFiniteKernel Expr ℝ :=
3739 ⟨previous.kernel ∘ₖ stepKernel.kernel, inferInstance⟩
3740 exact SFiniteKernel.piecewise
3741 valueSet_measurable SFiniteKernel.zero composed

3747theorem exactOutputKernel_apply
3748 (stepKernel : StepKernel) (depth : Nat) (expression : Expr) :
3749 exactOutputKernel stepKernel depth expression =
3750 exactOutputMeasure stepKernel depth expression := by

3752 induction depth generalizing expression with
3753 | zero =>
3754 unfold exactOutputKernel exactOutputKernelPack
3755 SFiniteKernel.piecewise
3756 SFiniteKernel.deterministic
3757 SFiniteKernel.zero
3758 rw [Kernel.piecewise_apply]
3759 cases expression <;>
3760 try simp [exactOutputMeasure, terminalFloatSet,
3761 terminalFloatValue, Kernel.deterministic_apply]
3762 | succ depth ih =>
3763 unfold exactOutputKernel exactOutputKernelPack
3764 SFiniteKernel.piecewise
3765 SFiniteKernel.zero
3766 unfold exactOutputMeasure
3767 rw [Kernel.piecewise_apply]
3768 by_cases isValue : expression.isValue = true
3769 · simp [valueSet, isValue]
3770 · have notMember : expression ∉ valueSet := isValue
3771 rw [if_neg notMember]
3772 rw [if_neg isValue]
3773 simp only [Kernel.comp_apply]
3774 congr 1
3775 funext successor
3776 exact ih successor

3813theorem map_restrict_terminal_eq_bind_exactZero
3814 (stepKernel : StepKernel) (measure : Measure Expr) :
3815 (measure.restrict terminalFloatSet).map terminalFloatValue =
3816 measure.bind (exactOutputKernel stepKernel 0) := by

3818 rw [Measure.map_apply terminalFloatValue_measurable measurableSet,

3833 (terminalFloatValue expression)) =

3836 rfl

3860theorem nStepKernel_commutes
3861 (stepKernel : StepKernel) (fuel : Nat) :
3862 stepKernel.kernel ∘ₖ (nStepKernelPack stepKernel fuel).kernel =
3863 (nStepKernelPack stepKernel fuel).kernel ∘ₖ stepKernel.kernel := by
3864 induction fuel with
3865 | zero =>
3866 rw [nStepKernelPack_zero_kernel]
3867 simp
3868 | succ fuel ih =>
3869 rw [nStepKernelPack_succ_kernel]
3870 calc
3871 stepKernel.kernel ∘ₖ
3872 (stepKernel.kernel ∘ₖ (nStepKernelPack stepKernel fuel).kernel) =
3873 stepKernel.kernel ∘ₖ
3874 ((nStepKernelPack stepKernel fuel).kernel ∘ₖ stepKernel.kernel) := by
3875 exact congrArg (fun kernel => stepKernel.kernel ∘ₖ kernel) ih
3876 _ = (stepKernel.kernel ∘ₖ (nStepKernelPack stepKernel fuel).kernel) ∘ₖ
3877 stepKernel.kernel := (Kernel.comp_assoc _ _ _).symm

3959theorem finsetSum_comp_kernel {α β γ ι : Type*}
3960 [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β] [MeasurableSpace γ]
3961 (indices : Finset ι) (kernels : ι → Kernel β γ) (kernel : Kernel α β) :
3962 (∑ index ∈ indices, kernels index) ∘ₖ kernel =
3963 ∑ index ∈ indices, kernels index ∘ₖ kernel := by
3964 classical
3965 induction indices using Finset.induction with
3966 | empty => simp
3967 | @insert index indices absent ih =>
3968 simp [Finset.sum_insert absent, Kernel.comp_add_left, ih]

3970theorem cumulativeKernel_eq_finsetSum
3971 (stepKernel : StepKernel) (fuel : Nat) :
3972 exactOutputKernel stepKernel 0 ∘ₖ (nStepKernelPack stepKernel fuel).kernel =
3973 ∑ depth ∈ Finset.range (fuel + 1), exactOutputKernel stepKernel depth := by
3974 induction fuel with
3975 | zero =>
3976 rw [nStepKernelPack_zero_kernel]
3977 simp
3978 | succ fuel ih =>
3979 rw [cumulativeKernel_succ, ih,
3980 finsetSum_comp_kernel, Finset.sum_range_succ']
3981 rw [exactOutputKernel_zero_comp_step]
3982 simp_rw [exactOutputKernel_succ_comp_step]
3983 rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
3984 have shifted :
3985 (∑ depth ∈ Finset.range (fuel + 1),
3986 exactOutputKernel stepKernel (depth + 1)) =
3987 exactOutputKernel stepKernel 1 +
3988 ∑ depth ∈ Finset.range fuel,
3989 exactOutputKernel stepKernel (depth + 2) := by
3990 rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
3991 simp only [Nat.zero_add, Nat.add_assoc]
3992 ac_rfl
3993 rw [shifted]
3994 ac_rfl
3995
3996theorem cumulativeOutputMeasure_eq_finsetSum
3997 (stepKernel : StepKernel) (fuel : Nat) (program : Expr) :
3998 cumulativeOutputMeasure stepKernel fuel program =
3999 ∑ depth ∈ Finset.range (fuel + 1),
4000 exactOutputMeasure stepKernel depth program := by
4001 rw [cumulativeOutputMeasure_eq_kernel]
4002 have kernelEquality := cumulativeKernel_eq_finsetSum stepKernel fuel
4003 have fiberEquality := congrArg (fun kernel : Kernel Expr ℝ => kernel program)
4004 kernelEquality
4005 rw [fiberEquality]
4006 simp only [FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
4007 apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
4008 intro depth _
4009 exact exactOutputKernel_apply stepKernel depth program

4011theorem measure_sum_eq_iSup_range_succ {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
4012 (measures : Nat → Measure α) :
4013 Measure.sum measures =
4014 ⨆ fuel, ∑ depth ∈ Finset.range (fuel + 1), measures depth := by
4015 apply le_antisymm
4016 · rw [Measure.le_iff]
4017 intro set measurableSet
4018 rw [Measure.sum_apply measures measurableSet, ENNReal.tsum_eq_iSup_nat]
4019 refine iSup_le fun fuel => ?_
4020 have finiteLe :
4021 (∑ depth ∈ Finset.range (fuel + 1), measures depth) ≤
4022 ⨆ fuel, ∑ depth ∈ Finset.range (fuel + 1), measures depth :=
4023 le_iSup (fun fuel => ∑ depth ∈ Finset.range (fuel + 1), measures depth) fuel
4024 have applyLe := Measure.le_iff.mp finiteLe set measurableSet
4025 have scalarLe :
4026 (∑ depth ∈ Finset.range fuel, measures depth set) ≤
4027 (∑ depth ∈ Finset.range (fuel + 1), measures depth set) := by
4028 rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
4029 exact le_add_right le_rfl
4030 exact scalarLe.trans <| by
4031 simpa [Measure.finsetSum_apply] using applyLe
4032 · refine iSup_le fun fuel => ?_
4033 rw [Measure.le_iff]
4034 intro set measurableSet
4035 rw [Measure.finsetSum_apply, Measure.sum_apply measures measurableSet,
4036 ENNReal.tsum_eq_iSup_nat]
4037 exact le_iSup (fun fuel => ∑ depth ∈ Finset.range fuel, measures depth set)
4038 (fuel + 1)

4040theorem bigStepMeasure_eq_sum_exactOutputMeasure (stepKernel : StepKernel) (program : Expr) :
4041 bigStepMeasure stepKernel program =
4042 Measure.sum (fun depth => exactOutputMeasure stepKernel depth program) := by
4043 unfold bigStepMeasure
4044 calc
4045 (⨆ fuel, cumulativeOutputMeasure stepKernel fuel program) =
4046 ⨆ fuel, ∑ depth ∈ Finset.range (fuel + 1),
4047 exactOutputMeasure stepKernel depth program := by
4048 apply iSup_congr
4049 intro fuel
4050 exact cumulativeOutputMeasure_eq_finsetSum stepKernel fuel program
4051 _ = Measure.sum (fun depth => exactOutputMeasure stepKernel depth program) :=
4052 (measure_sum_eq_iSup_range_succ
4053 (fun depth => exactOutputMeasure stepKernel depth program)).symm
